1.title: Armed Ohio man arrested after charging at Democratic candidate for governor
1.summary: The candidate, Amy Acton, was not hurt, but her team said several others were injured as the man tried to "lunge" at her.

2.title: Pilot killed in small plane crash near regional airport in Florida
2.summary: The National Transportation Safety Board has identified the plane as a Mooney M20F aircraft, a four-seater propeller plane.

3.title: Investigators begin work on why cargo plane overran Miami runway
3.summary: Five people died and five others were injured as the Amazon plane overshot the runway after landing at Miami International Airport.

4.title: Britain Set to Target Israeli West Bank Settlements With Trade Ban
4.summary: The expected move will be announced on Tuesday, officials said, and underscored Israel’s mounting isolation over its policies toward Palestinians following the war in Gaza.

5.title: Germany’s ‘Firewall’ Against the Far Right Is Being Tested as Never Before
5.summary: A blowout win by the far-right Alternative for Germany party in a state election has revealed a split among voters about whether to uphold a decades-old strategy for sidelining extremists.

6.title: After Victory in German State, Far Right Needs Help to Take Power
6.summary: The Alternative for Germany, or AfD, does not have a straightforward path to governing Saxony-Anhalt, but a small populist party could clear the way.
